l: L is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions.
L can also mean being ten more than forty.
L can also mean the cardinal number that is the product of ten and five.
L means the same as liter or litre or cubic decimeter.
l'aquila: L'Aquila is the provincial capital of the Abruzzi region in central Italy.
L'Aquila means the same as Aquila or Aquila degli Abruzzi.
l'enfant: L'Enfant is United States architect who laid out the city plan for Washington.
L'Enfant means the same as Charles L'Enfant or Pierre Charles L'Enfant.
l-dopa: L-dopa is the levorotatory form of dopa.
L-dopa means the same as levodopa or Bendopa or Brocadopa.
l-p: L-P is a long-playing phonograph record.
L-P means the same as LP.
l-plate: L-plate is a square plate bearing the letter L that is attached to both ends of a car to indicate that the driver is a learner.
l. m. montgomery: L. M. Montgomery is Canadian novelist.
L. M. Montgomery means the same as Montgomery or Lucy Maud Montgomery.
l. monocytogenes: L. monocytogenes is the type species of the genus Listeria.
L. monocytogenes means the same as Listeria monocytogenes.
l. ron hubbard: L. Ron Hubbard is a United States writer of science fiction and founder of Scientology.
L. Ron Hubbard means the same as Hubbard.
l. s. lowry: L. S. Lowry is English painter.
L. S. Lowry means the same as Lowry or Laurence Stephen Lowry.
L.A. is a city in southern California.
L.A. means the same as Los Angeles or City of the Angels.
l-shaped: L-shaped means shaped in the form of the letter L.
